Container.Name: ytarchive
Container.Overview:
Archives YouTube playlists and channels locally. Point it at a playlist or a whole channel, choose a quality, and it keeps a local copy of everything in it — then re-checks on an interval and picks up anything new.
Per-source quality (original down to 360p, or audio-only) and container (original / mkv / mp4, or m4a / mp3 / opus / flac). Three independent guards prevent the same video being downloaded twice, so restarts and lost state are safe.
IMPORTANT: the web interface has no login unless you set YTARCHIVE_AUTH. Anyone who can reach the port can add sources and start downloads, so set a password if this host is not fully trusted.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, database and logs. Small — but back it up, it is what stops videos being re-downloaded.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where archived videos are written - pick any share or folder. Each playlist and channel gets its own folder inside it; single videos go straight into it.

Config.Name: Check interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often to look for new videos. 0 disables automatic checks.

Config.Name: Login (user:password)
Config.Description: STRONGLY RECOMMENDED. Format: user:password - or just a password, then any username works. Without this the interface is open to anyone who can reach the port, and it can start downloads and change settings.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns written files. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns written files. Unraid default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: yt-dlp auto-update (hours)
Config.Description: How often to update yt-dlp while the container runs. YouTube breaks older versions within weeks and downloads then stop silently, so keep this on. 0 disables it.

Config.Name: yt-dlp channel
Config.Description: stable, or nightly to receive YouTube fixes days or weeks sooner. Switch to nightly if downloads keep failing.
